channel.title: Illumineers Digest
channel.description: Weekly Disney Lorcana tournament results, news and community highlights.

item.title: Hyperia City launches: first Set 14 weekend has Amber/Emerald, Amber/Amethyst and Emerald/Steel winning, plus two big CCQs
item.description: Hyperia City (Set 14: 242 cards, Coco and the new Ink Drop mechanic) went on general sale Oct. 23, a week after the Oct. 16 prereleases. • The first Set 14 Core weekend had different winners in different places. Amber/Amethyst won Heroes Ink in Germany, Amber/Emerald Songs won Top Deck Keep in the US, and Steel/Emerald Evasive won Quest Coast IV. • Two Core Constructed Qualifiers that award NAC invites ran on Oct. 24. BlingGuest won the 144-player Lorca-Breizh CCQ in France, and Darian won the 79-player Through the Decades Infinity 5K in the US. • Ravensburger revealed Collector Boosters and a new Illustrious rarity. Both arrive with Into the Inkdark on Feb. 12, 2027, and will only be sold at Ravensburger Play Hub stores, Ravensburger's online store and select Disney locations. • The Quest World Iconic Clash, a 16-player invitational where the prize is an iconic Hades – Looking for a Deal, published all 16 decklists and is releasing Round 1 matches. Amber/Emerald Songs and Emerald/Amethyst Retro are the most common decks.

item.title: Hyperia City hits shelves, first Set 14 invitational goes to EdLorcana, and Inkdark Collector Boosters get details
item.description: Set 14, Hyperia City, went on general sale October 23 after prereleases that started October 16. It adds Coco and the new ink drop mechanic, and the release notes change how stacked keywords work and issue errata for Jukebox. • Edmond Chiu (EdLorcana) won the 16-player Quest World Iconic Clash invitational on October 17, the first big look at Set 14 decks. His list was titled "Emerald / Steel", and several of the broadcast matches were Emerald/Steel. • Into the Inkdark (Set 15) preorders are open for a reported February 12, 2027 release. It brings 12-card all-foil Collector Boosters and the serialized Illustrious rarity (23 copies of each card). Collector Boosters will be sold only at select Play Hub stores and Disney locations. • Flash is the first card people are calling broken in the new format. Manifest TCG calls it a new Steel staple, and Reddit says it's overtuned at 2 cost.
